changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.41[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Faster browsing[/COLOR]
-A page of 20 movies now hands Kodi about 320 KB instead of 2.5 MB. The full cast no longer travels inside every title's play link; the player reads it back when playback starts, so the cast still shows.
-Settings are read once per click instead of hundreds of times, and titles are handed to Kodi in one go instead of one by one.
-While you browse, the precache, the Catalog Update and the artwork upgrade pause and let the menu go first (at most 20 seconds).
-New: ready-made pages for the TMDb categories of Movies and TV Shows (Trending, Popular, Networks, Genres, Years, Languages and the rest). A page shows at once, even when it is getting old, and is rebuilt in the background for the next visit.
-The metadata, cache, fanart and Trakt databases let the menus read while the service writes, and new metadata is stored in a format that loads much faster. What is already cached still works.
-The main menu no longer looks inside the download folders, so a sleeping network drive no longer makes it wait.
-Collections, menus and TMDb pages build their entries faster, and a TMDb server error no longer keeps you waiting about 3 seconds.
-Progress and Playback lists from Trakt and SIMKL prepare at most 10 shows at a time instead of one thread per show.
-The first menu after a cold start no longer waits up to 1.5 seconds to learn whether the screen is 4K.
[COLOR fffdb515]Menus and pictures[/COLOR]
-Movies and TV Shows list their entries grouped by service: For You, TMDb, Trakt, SIMKL, MDBList, PunchPlay, WeTrakr (and TVmaze in TV Shows), then Play an NZB, My Lists and Search.
-Every icon, logo, flag and genre picture is now 512x512 and no larger than 100 KB, with the same colours, gradients and reflections. Screenshots stay widescreen and the "poster not available" picture keeps its poster shape. The add-on is about 1.5 MB smaller.
[COLOR fffdb515]Trakt[/COLOR]
-Fixed: background checks could use up Trakt's request allowance, and then everything asked of Trakt was refused for minutes with a "Trakt is busy" notification each time. Background work now goes at one request per second, at most 200 every five minutes, steps aside while you browse or watch, and the busy notice shows once.
-Liked lists are checked within that allowance, one request per list when that is enough, and lists that have not changed are not asked for again.
-When your last liked list, your last list or your last paused video is removed on Trakt, luc_kodi now empties its copy too.
-Fixed: a paused title without a runtime broke the whole Continue Watching list, and Trakt lists could fail on a fresh install before the first sync.
-Marking as watched while Trakt does not answer now fails cleanly.
[COLOR fffdb515]Sources and playback[/COLOR]
-Sorting and filtering thousands of sources is much faster, and the sources window opens faster with long lists.
-Each scraper closes its database connection when it finishes.
-Fixed: the stop-early limit stopped the search one round late.
-Subtitles appear about one second sooner, and pausing a video no longer deletes them and searches OpenSubtitles again.
-Fixed: the progress window could stay open when a newer playback replaced the one starting.
[COLOR fffdb515]Watched marks and queue[/COLOR]
-Fixed: opening a TV show folder (genres, networks, years) emptied Kodi's play queue.
-Without a tracking account, marking a whole show or season as watched or unwatched is saved in one go.
[COLOR fffdb515]Usenet[/COLOR]
-Sending a large NZB from your phone uses about half the memory, and 7z sets and disc images open faster.
-File names inside RAR4 archives keep their accents, disc images keep the volume details while you browse large folders, and a broken 7z header is refused.
-Cleaning old NZB files no longer delays start-up.
[COLOR fffdb515]Start-up and settings[/COLOR]
-Tasks that are not urgent (catalog, posters, premieres, maintenance, update check, Sync Trakt collection on start) start 10 to 20 seconds after Kodi, so the Home screen loads first.
-Fixed: after every update luc_kodi said "1 Obsolete Settings Entries Removed" and removed a setting that was still in use. The clean-up now runs once per update, silently.
-Removed three switches that did nothing: "Enable Notification Sound", "Enable" under External Scrapers and a hidden MDBList switch.
-Fixed: Reset metadata keys (TMDb, TheTVDB, Fanart) did nothing, an empty Trakt sync interval stopped the service from starting, and a failed download or playback-progress removal could leave the loading circle on screen.
-The search history and resume points wait for each other instead of failing with "database is locked".
-JustWatch: an unexpected answer now fails cleanly.
